title: Recognize What $$value_{counts}$$ Stores
text: $$fav_{flavors}$$ stores how many times each soda flavor appears. The index contains the flavor names, and the values contain the counts.

title: Parts of a $$value_{counts}$$ Series
text: In $$fav_{flavors}$$, what do fav_flavors.index and fav_flavors.values represent?

title: Why countplot Works
text: $$sns.countplot(data=staff_{poll}$$, $$x="flavor")$$ counts each category directly from the original $$staff_{poll}$$ data, recreating the same frequency information as $$fav_{flavors}$$.

title: Eliminate Histograms and Boxplots
text: A histogram and a boxplot are mainly used for numerical distributions. Here, the goal is to compare counts for categorical soda flavors.

title: Why plt.bar Works
text: plt.bar(fav_flavors.index, fav_flavors.values) uses the flavor names as the x-axis categories and the counts as the bar heights, so it directly visualizes the $$value_{counts}$$ Series.
